nodes.label: Clean Architecture Layering
nodes.rationale: Fixes v1 tight coupling (drawing, thresholding, OpenCV I/O and YOLO mixed in one function, untestable without model+GUI); domain is pure Python with no numpy/cv2/torch/fastapi imports.

nodes.label: Structured Logging (structlog)
nodes.rationale: Replaces print with leveled logs: pretty console in dev, JSON in production, request_id per request.

nodes.label: Docker Deployment
nodes.rationale: Non-root image, read-only filesystem, HEALTHCHECK, OpenCV headless; CPU torch by default with CUDA build arg.

nodes.label: HELMET_* Environment Configuration
nodes.rationale: All configuration via env vars / .env validated by pydantic so deployment needs no code changes.

nodes.label: Legacy Script Shims (train.py, val.py, inference.py)
nodes.rationale: Backward compatibility: old scripts still run by delegating to the new CLI.

nodes.label: Architecture & Audit Report (v2.0)
nodes.source_location: Kiến trúc & Báo cáo kiểm toán (v2.0)

nodes.label: Inference Concurrency Model (lock + CapacityLimiter)
nodes.rationale: Ultralytics predictor is not thread-safe, so adapter locks predict; API caps max_concurrency; scale via workers/replicas, each loading its own model.

nodes.label: Dataset YAML Validation & Absolute Paths
nodes.rationale: Relative path: data in data.yaml is resolved against Ultralytics' global datasets_dir, causing 'dataset not found'; v2 validates nc/names/splits and writes an absolute-path copy.

nodes.label: Inference Timeout (504)
nodes.rationale: Python cannot cancel threads, so on timeout the request returns 504 immediately while inference finishes in background; limiter slot is released but the model lock may still delay the next request.

nodes.label: Input Validation & Typed Errors
nodes.rationale: Guards against corrupt images, bad formats, out-of-range thresholds, decompression bombs (40 MP), dropped streams; typed error hierarchy with a global error handler.

nodes.label: Safe Weights Download (retry, timeout, atomic write)
nodes.norm_label: safe weights download (retry, timeout, atomic write)
nodes.rationale: urlretrieve had no timeout/retry and wrote partial files; v2 uses httpx streaming, tenacity exponential back-off with jitter, HTTPS-only, atomic .part rename and minimum size check.

nodes.label: Exit Code 2 on Violation (--fail-on-violation)
nodes.rationale: Allows integration with cron, CI and camera pipelines by signalling violations via process exit code.

nodes.label: Helmet/Head-to-Person Matching Rule
nodes.rationale: v1 only counted boxes and could not say which worker lacks a helmet; v2 greedily assigns helmets/heads (by confidence, each helmet once) within the top 50% head region of each person box; orphan head = violation, orphan helmet = compliant unless dominated by higher-confidence head.

nodes.label: Explicit Weights Resolution Order
nodes.rationale: v1 fell back to newest best.pt by mtime, which after git clone could pick a broken 1-epoch run or COCO weights; v2 uses an explicit resolver chain and raises ModelNotFoundError instead of silently using a wrong model.
